rows.grounds: compound of vahni (fire/citraka), mūla (root), and yuta (joined/with)
compound of manuṣya (human), gara (poison), and nāśana (destroying)

items.question: What combination of citraka root and milk destroys human poison?
premises: citraka root is joined with milk
uncertainties: vahni may denote citraka root in this medical context
items.plain_english: Milk combined with citraka root destroys human poison.
